reviews.review_description: No menus, no anything really, 3 step tutorial, 1 box of cards, once they sell there is no way of buying more. This game is not ready for release.

developer_response.body:
Thank you for your feedback! We’d like to clarify that the game offers more features than may be apparent during the initial tutorial. There is an **Inventory Room located behind the shop**, which you can also access by walking out of the shop and going around to the back. Inside, you’ll find a PC where you can order new items for your store and earn extra cash.

We understand that the tutorial may not explain all these mechanics clearly enough, and we apologize for that. Our team is working on improving and expanding the tutorial to help players understand the gameplay better. We’ll continue adding improvements to make the experience more enjoyable. We appreciate your feedback and hope you’ll explore more of what the game has to offer!
